description: Change the shared event everyone sees on the RSVP page: title, date/time, place or description. Only after the group agreed. Times are local (no time zone); omit start_time for an all-day event. Send only the fields to change; an empty string clears a field. After the requested changes, call get_plan for this same plan before reporting the saved result.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.

name: update_event
title: Update the event
